case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your options, but the proposed DAP delivery and 35-day lead time would significantly increase the cost due to freight and expediting. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To provide you with the most competitive rate, we propose keeping the terms at EXW and a 45-day lead time. On this basis, we are pleased to offer a reduced price of EUR 15.90 per unit. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms, with a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.90 per unit.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
